moves.label: Trade: Josh Hart, Daniel Diez, Bojan Dubljevic, Ryan Arcidiacono, Svi Mykhailiuk and others
moves.description: Josh Hart, the draft rights to Daniel Diez and the draft rights to Bojan Dubljevic were acquired by the New York Knicks in exchange for Ryan Arcidiacono, Svi Mykhailiuk, Cam Reddish, the draft rights to Ante Tomic and a conditional 2023 1st round pick (NYK own). Svi Mykhailiuk, a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick, a More Favorable 2027 2nd round pick and a TPE were acquired by the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for Jalen McDaniels and a 2024 2nd round pick (NYK own). Jalen McDaniels, a 2024 2nd round pick (NYK own), a 2029 2nd round pick (POR own) and a TPE were acquired by the Philadelphia Sixers in exchange for Matisse Thybulle and a More Favorable 2023 2nd round pick. Ryan Arcidiacono, Cam Reddish, Matisse Thybulle, the draft rights to Ante Tomic, a conditional 2023 1st round pick (NYK own) and a TPE were acquired by the Portland Trail Blazers in exchange for Josh Hart, the draft rights to Daniel Diez, the draft rights to Bojan Dubljevic, a More Favorable 2027 2nd round pick and a 2029 2nd round pick (POR own).

moves.label: Trade: Mason Plumlee, Reggie Jackson
moves.description: Mason Plumlee and a TPE were acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers from the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for: Reggie Jackson, a 2028 2nd round pick (LAC own) and cash.

moves.description: A 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own) was acquired by the Philadelphia Sixers in exchange for Buddy Hield. Klay Thompson and a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick were acquired by the Dallas Mavericks in exchange for Josh Green and a 2031 2nd round pick (DAL own). Kyle Anderson and Buddy Hield were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for Klay Thompson, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks and cash. Josh Green, Reggie Jackson, a 2029 2nd round pick (DEN own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (DEN own) were acquired by the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for a 2025 2nd round pick (PHL own) and cash. A 2025 2nd round pick (PHL own), cash and a TPE were acquired by the Denver Nuggets in exchange for Reggie Jackson, a More Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a 2029 2nd round pick (DEN own) and a 2030 2nd round pick (DEN own). A Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks, cash and a TPE were acquired by the Minnesota Timberwolves in exchange for Kyle Anderson.

moves.label: Trade: Karl-Anthony Towns, James Nnaji, Keita Bates-Diop, Charlie Brown, Jr., Donte DiVincenzo and others
moves.description: Karl-Anthony Towns and the draft rights to James Nnaji were acquired by the New York Knicks in exchange for Keita Bates-Diop, Charlie Brown, Jr., Donte DiVincenzo, DaQuan Jeffries, Julius Randle, Duane Washington, Jr., a conditional 2023 1st round pick (DET own), a 2026 2nd round pick (GOS own), a 2031 2nd round pick (NYK own) and cash. Keita Bates-Diop, Donte DiVincenzo, Julius Randle, a conditional 2023 1st round pick (DET own) and a TPE were acquired by the Minnesota Timberwolves in exchange for Karl-Anthony Towns and a Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick. Charlie Brown, Jr., DaQuan Jeffries, Duane Washington, Jr., a Least Favorable 2025 2nd round pick, a 2026 2nd round pick (GOS own), a 2031 2nd round pick (NYK own) and cash were acquired by the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for the draft rights to James Nnaji.

moves.label: Roster move: Mouhamadou Gueye
moves.description: Mouhamadou Gueye, previously with the Charlotte Hornets, became a free agent.

moves.label: Trade: Max Strus, Ismael Kamagate, Peyton Watson, Peyton Watson, Cam Whitmore and others
moves.description: Max Strus was acquired by the Los Angeles Clippers in exchange for the draft rights to Ismael Kamagate, a 2027 2nd round pick (PHL own) and a TPE. A 2031 1st round pick (CLE own), a 2032 2nd round pick (SAC own) and a TPE were acquired by the Denver Nuggets in exchange for Peyton Watson. Peyton Watson, Cam Whitmore, the draft rights to Ismael Kamagate and a TPE were acquired by the Cleveland Cavaliers in exchange for Dennis Schroder, Max Strus, a 2031 1st round pick (CLE own), a 2032 2nd round pick (SAC own), cash and a TPE. Dennis Schroder and cash were acquired by the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for Tre Mann. Tre Mann, a 2027 2nd round pick (PHL own) and cash were acquired by the Washington Wizards in exchange for Cam Whitmore.
